title: [Master]-For an Item of 'Type' Service or Non-Inventory we allow you to increase the Quantity of the Corrective Credit Memo which then if posted updates the Purchase Order with a negative Received and Invoiced values
summary: Fixes corrective credit memos from posted purchase invoices with Service or Non-Inventory lines. Before, the quantity could be increased, and posting the credit memo left negative Received and Invoiced values on the original purchase order. Purchase Line and Correct Posted Purch. Invoice are changed in W1 and the localization layers.
key_points: Addresses quantity increases on corrective credit memos for Service and Non-Inventory purchase lines
Before the fix, posting such a credit memo left negative Received and Invoiced values on the purchase order
Changes Purchase Line (table 39) and Correct Posted Purch. Invoice (codeunit 1313) across W1 and the localization layers
Adds tests to O365CorrectPurchaseInvoice in several layers
